Sets a 3x3 matrix that is applied to every model loaded from files with a certain extension, to correct a file format whose axes differ from Blitz3D. By default `.x` files are used as they are and `.3ds` files get Y and Z swapped. Only the file type matters, not the case.
@param file_ext  File extension the matrix is for, for example `x` or `3ds`.
@param xx        Matrix value, row 1, column 1.
@param xy        Matrix value, row 1, column 2.
@param xz        Matrix value, row 1, column 3.
@param yx        Matrix value, row 2, column 1.
@param yy        Matrix value, row 2, column 2.
@param yz        Matrix value, row 2, column 3.
@param zx        Matrix value, row 3, column 1.
@param zy        Matrix value, row 3, column 2.
@param zz        Matrix value, row 3, column 3.
@gap The matrix is remembered but never used. Since only `.b3d` files can be loaded, and those are not changed by it in the original either, there is no visible effect yet.
